summary: When wicked Queen Athaliah tried to wipe out the royal family, baby Joash was rescued and hidden in God's temple for six years. At seven years old, he was crowned king, and later he repaired the temple.

story_reel.narration: In the southern kingdom of Judah, a wicked woman named Athaliah wanted to be queen so badly that she tried to destroy the whole royal family. But one brave woman named Jehosheba, the king's sister, rescued her baby nephew, Joash. She hid him and his nurse in a bedroom, and then in the temple of Yahweh. For six whole years, little Joash grew up secretly in God's house, while Athaliah ruled the land. Imagine playing hide-and-seek for six years! When Joash was seven years old, the priest Jehoiada made a brave plan. He gathered the temple guards and gave them King David's own spears and shields from the temple. They stood all around the young prince. Then Jehoiada brought Joash out, put the crown on his head, gave him a copy of God's law, and anointed him king. The people clapped their hands and shouted, 'Long live the king!' Joash was only seven years old when he became king! Jehoiada taught him to follow Yahweh. When Joash grew up, he noticed that God's temple was falling apart. So he had a chest made with a hole in its lid and placed it beside the altar. People brought their offerings and dropped them in. The money was used to pay carpenters, builders, and stonemasons to repair God's house. You are never too young for God to use you.

memory_verse.text: Remember also your Creator in the days of your youth

identity_focus.core_truth: I am never too young for Yahweh to use me for something good.
identity_focus.reflection_prompt: Joash became king at seven and later repaired God's house! What is something good you could do for God right now, even though you're young?

quiz.question: How long was Joash hidden in the temple?
quiz.explanation: He was with her hidden in Yahweh's house six years.

quiz.question: How old was Joash when he became king?
quiz.explanation: Jehoash was seven years old when he began to reign.

quiz.question: What did Joash use to collect money to repair the temple?
options: A chest with a hole in its lid
quiz.explanation: Jehoiada the priest took a chest, bored a hole in its lid, and set it beside the altar.

micro_prayer.text: Yahweh, I'm never too young for You to use me. Help me remember You now, while I'm young, and help me do good things for You. Amen.

companion.message: Joash grew up in God's house, just like Samuel did. A seven-year-old king! God loves to use young people. That includes you!

review.notes: Sensitive: Athaliah murders the royal family (2 Kings 11:1), described as 'tried to destroy the whole royal family'; nothing shown. Athaliah's execution (11:13-16) is omitted. Joash's later decline (2 Chronicles 24:17-25) is omitted. Confirm.
